title: Melee Exposure
summary: Melee Exposure is a Melee Arcane Enhancement.
extract:
Melee Exposure is a Melee Arcane Enhancement.
When you cast an ability, you will apply  Corrosive Damage to melee strikes.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for killing The Fragmented on Effervo, Deimos.
Awarded for killing Whispers in Albrecht's Laboratories missions.
Awarded for killing Gruzzlings in non-Disruption Albrecht's Laboratories mission.
Can be bought from Bird 3 of  Cavia for  7,500, requiring Rank 4 - Scholar.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Transference nor Operator abilities count as an Ability Cast for triggering this Arcane as Update 37.0 (2024-10-02) undocumented change/fix.
Bonus stacks share the same duration, which refresh upon each trigger, and all will expire at once when the duration ends.
Affects Exalted and Pseudo-Exalted weapons when equipped on them such as:
 Ash's  Shadow Clones
 Atlas's  Landslide Fists
 Baruuk's  Desert Wind
 Excalibur's  Exalted Blade
 Excalibur's  Slash Dash
 Gara's  Shattered Lash
 Garuda's  Garuda Talons
 Khora's  Whipclaw
 Sevagoth's  Shadow Claws
 Titania's  Diwata
 Valkyr's  Valkyr Talons
 Wukong's  Iron Staff
